title: Character Inspector
description:
```
Enter a character: g
Character: g
ASCII code: 103
Uppercase: G
Is letter? true   Is digit? false   Is upper? false
Next char: h      Previous char: f
Binary: 01100111
```
hints: `std::toupper` returns an `int`, so print `static_cast<char>(std::toupper(c))`. The `is...` functions also return an `int` (non-zero for yes); `static_cast<bool>(std::isalpha(c))` prints as true or false.
The next character is `static_cast<char>(c + 1)`. The binary is `std::bitset<8>(c)`.
requirements: Convert results to `bool` for `boolalpha` printing (`std::isalpha` returns `int`)
